description: This PHP source file defines the DataValidations class responsible for handling data validation ranges and settings within an Excel worksheet when reading XLSX files using PhpSpreadsheet. The class processes data validation XML nodes, extracts cell ranges, and applies validation settings to worksheet cells.

classes.name: DataValidations
classes.description: Handles reading and applying data validation rules from XLSX worksheet XML to worksheet cells in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DataValidations object with a worksheet and corresponding XML data validation node.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Processes the XML data validation nodes, extracts cell ranges, and applies validation settings to the relevant worksheet cells.
